appearance_facts.fact: A large orange-red wedge labeled 'Nuclear (45%)' spans roughly from the 12 o'clock position to about 4-5 o'clock, making it the visually largest slice.

appearance_facts.fact: A red wedge labeled 'Hydroelectric (30%)' occupies the bottom-right portion, smaller than the Nuclear slice.
A pale yellow wedge labeled 'Fossil Fuels (15%)' sits on the lower-left side.
A light orange wedge labeled 'Renewables (10%)' is the smallest slice, in the top-left area.
Title text 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' appears in bold black at the top.
